paragraphs.text: The Marvel Super Heroes Art Series is a series of 45 art cards that can be found in Marvel Super Heroes Collector Boosters . The set also includes a special nine-card collectible scene of Björn Barends 's artwork for Thanos, the Mad Titan with different drop rates in Collector Boosters.

The front face of each card is a full art illustration from the set in either landscape or portrait orientation. The card back is mostly blank with some collector information, including the Magic logo, illustration credits, legal text, and collector number . Art Series cards are similar to an artist 's proofs and thus provide room to get an artist's signature or drawing on it. They can be used by players as tokens for copy effects , as proxies , or if it is for a legendary creature it could be a good way to store experience counters , life total, commander tax, etc.

There are no foil art cards. Instead, all of them are treated with a specially developed gloss varnish that brings out the art. The backs are left uncoated. The main series of 45 art cards appear 31% of the time in the 16th slot of Collector Boosters (alternating with tokens ). Four percent of the time, rather than a normal art card, you'll get one with a gold-stamped signature of the artist. Every art card exists in both its normal version and its signature version. The nine Björn Barends art cards can be found in 5% of Collector Boosters and are only available as full art versions; they do not come with a gold-stamped signature.
In total, Marvel Super Heroes Collector Boosters have a 36% chance of containing an art card.
Marvel Super Heroes features two Scene Boxes with 12 additional art cards. These cards are designed to display the scene while the full Magic cards are being used for play.
